instruction: Candid documentary photograph from a high-angle overhead view of an office meeting room. Around a wooden table, a diverse business team stacks their hands in the center. On the left, the man with wavy grey hair (R1) in a brown suit leans forward. At the top-center, the bald Black man (R3) in a white shirt and black tie joins the stack. On the top-right, the older Black man (R4) in a dark suit and red tie leans in. On the right, the woman with curly black hair (R2) in a black top places her hand. In the foreground, a bystander with short white hair in a grey jacket sits with her back to the camera, adding her hand to the stack. The lighting is bright and even.
